description: This file is a shell script intended for performing performance tests related to Git's filesystem monitoring (fsmonitor) feature. It defines setup procedures, configuration toggles, and testing workflows for measuring repository status command performance under various configurations, such as with untracked cache and fsmonitor daemon enabled or disabled.

methods.name: enable_uc
methods.description: Enables the untracked cache in the specified Git repository.

methods.name: disable_uc
methods.description: Disables the untracked cache in the specified Git repository.

methods.name: start_fsm
methods.description: Starts the fsmonitor daemon for the repository and configures it to track filesystem changes.

methods.name: stop_fsm
methods.description: Stops the fsmonitor daemon and unsets related configuration.

methods.name: do_status
methods.description: Executes 'git status' and measures performance for the repository.

methods.name: do_matrix
methods.description: Performs a set of Git operations under specific configurations of untracked cache and fsmonitor daemon, including modifications, commits, resets, and cleanup.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up the test repository by deleting branches and reverting state.
